paper_metadata.title: Measuring the Fracture Toughness of TZM and ODS Molybdenum Alloys Using Standard and Sub-Sized Bend Specimens

evidence.quote: Fracture toughness values for TZM molybdenum as a function of temperature from -1 OOOC to 450 oc for longitudinal (circle) and transverse (square) orientations for results obtained from IT Charpy specimens compared with results for: (a) 0.5T Charpy specimens in the longitudinal (open diamond) and transverse directions (open square), and (b) 0.25T Charpy specimens in the longitudinal (open diamond) and transverse directions (open square).

Plot of fracture toughness values for ODS molybdenum versus temperature from -1500C to 3500C for longitudinal (circle) and transverse (square) orientations for results obtained from IT Charpy specimens compared with results for: (a) 0.5T Charpy specimens in the longitudinal (open diamond) and transverse directions (open square), and (b) 0.25T Charpy specimens in the longitudinal (open diamond) and transverse directions (open square).
